scratchpad: As the pricing manager of Firm A, my duty is to act in the best interests of the firm and its shareholders. The firm is facing a loss of 300 in profit. Option 1 allows me to cancel this loss by giving up 3 sessions of my own personal free time. Option 2 results in a loss of 300 for the firm's shareholders. Since my professional responsibility is to maximize the firm's value and minimize its losses, I should choose the option that protects the firm's profit, even at a personal cost to my free time.
